description: List the pages this API key's supervised browser profile visited, newest first, across sessions: URL, title, time, session id and whether the agent or a human held control. Sign-in callback codes and tokens are never stored. To reopen an entry, navigate to its url.

before.description: An entry_id from an earlier page (next_before): return older entries.

limit.description: How many entries to return. Default 50, maximum 200.

query.description: Only entries whose URL or title contains this text (case-insensitive).

name: list_history
